mentions.name: Hyperia
mentions.description: Agentic cross-platform terminal emulator forked from Hyper with a Rust sidecar. Features minimalist multi-pane views, tabs for pane groups, built-in browser panes with markdown conversion and screenshot ability, a fully searchable sticky notes feature (Stickys) with scheduling, webpanes with JavaScript injection and inspection/log reading by agents, intra-pane/tab communication so agents can talk to or control each other, an MCP/HTTP server for full agent control, bare metal agent support, 135+ tools exposed through a tool discovery tree, and full ACLs for destructive actions. Local Ollama model support for config/style and layout control is in progress.
